'''Master 666 THE DUEL BEGINS (HD -R-U-L-E-Z)''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Master 666]] posted on DeckTech. The byline 'Jedi "Master 666" Skali' reads as a joke name, so the deck is credited by the DeckTech handle "Master 666".<ref name="dt-12090">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12090 THE DUEL BEGINS (HD -R-U-L-E-Z)], DeckTech (Jedi "Master 666" Skali, 29 November 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12090/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12090/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018091011/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12090/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''THE DUEL BEGINS (HD -R-U-L-E-Z)'''
* '''Author:''' Jedi "Master 666" Skali
* '''Published:''' November 29, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' A HUNT DOWN DECK ; WHICH USESDB FOR AKTIVATION

=== Strategy ===

==== Starting ====

Hunt Down  and Destroy the Jedi Epic Duel Holotheatre Visage of the Emporer Meditation Chamber Preparen Defenses Mobilisation Points Imperial Arrest Order And You cannot Hide Forever ( against anything) Imperial Decree  (against Ebo) No Escape (against Upspring )

Why Yavin 4 DB and Hoth DB , (they are Rebel Base Location) , because with Imperial Decree you can Cancal opponets Force Drain Bonuses and can Cancel Revolution

Why Sim aloo and Janus Greetjatus , when they are deployed to the Emporer they are Really Cheap , and they make you win duels (janus for your own Destinys and Sim to Manupulate opponents Destiny)

Why Control , because Sense and Alter Destiny draws are +4 And it can cancel forcedrains

VS Hidden BAse Get your all your ships to one System and drain there (make beatdowns with zuckus and the other BH ships for multiple destinys) Visage will hurt them , if they play mains track your destinys and duel luke , obi .

VS EBO start with Imperial Decree , get control of Hoth DB and Yavin 4 DB (but be careful of speeder Beatdowns) so Ebo dosent hurt you
